audience.description: Writers, editors, and developers evaluating AI-assisted editorial workflows

intent: Announce the repository without unsupported adoption, maturity, or performance claims
constraints: Do not invent users, adoption, metrics, or testimonials
Do not present roadmap work as shipped
Do not present reference tooling as a universally conforming production engine

input.brief: Write a concise Telegram announcement for the Human Writing Rules repository using only the pinned repository documents.

evaluation.instructions: Evaluate the pinned post without revealing arm identity when practical. Preserve raw ratings and treat unsupported maturity, adoption, or performance language as a hard failure.

hard_failures.description: The post invents users, adoption, demand, testimonials, or community response.
The post claims measured quality or productivity improvement without evidence.
Reference tooling is presented as a universally conforming production engine.
The post announces a feature absent from the pinned source set.
An unresolved blocker is labeled publication-ready.

known_limitations: This case covers one Russian Telegram product announcement.
Repository documents are authored by the project and are not independent evidence.
The offline fixture adapter validates execution mechanics, not writing quality.
